# Why Spider man is such a great Superhero

## Its not because hes hot.

Against contrary belief, his looks is not the only thing that makes him so popular.

[Spider mans newest movie](https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/movies/a66024733/tom-holland-spider-man-brand-new-day-news/)

He is a young teenager from New York, and he embodies that **perfectly**. In superhero movies, especially among popular hero, its rare to get the youth to be represented in such an accurate way. But Spider man does it right *every time*.

![Miles Morales Spider man](images(6).jpeg)

Why Spider man is better then other Avengers/popular hero:
- He feels the most human.
- The "with great power comes great responsibility" theme is universal.
- He's funny without being emotionless.

Best scenes that prove this:
1. Peter's first meeting with Tony Stark — Captain America: Civil War
2. If you were good enough, maybe Tony would have called you" — Spider-Man: Homecoming
3. Peter saves the Washington Monument — Homecoming
4. "I don't want to go" — Infinity War
